column2: What admirable words. But what does any of that have to do with me?{wait}{clear}
Who cares, as long as it's not about me?!{wait}{clear}Other people... to me...{wait}{clear}they don't matter one bit!{wait}{clear}
Are you all right? Thanks for the lip-service comfort.{wait}{clear}
Let's go back to the inn{n}
Why don't we go back to the inn and rest? You're tired.{wait}{clear}
Shouldn't you go a little easier on the drinking, Rocus...?{wait}{clear}
Do this... do that, don't do this... don't do that...{wait}{clear}
You people... don't give a damn what I think, do you?!{wait}{clear}
I want to apologize to you...{wait}{clear}
Back then, I said terrible things to you...{wait}{clear}
I wasn't myself... Please forgive me...{wait}{clear}
Rocus... why...{wait}{clear}But I believe in you, Rocus. I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
I know plenty of ladies who'd be delighted to be treated like this.{wait}{clear}
Are you really the kind of person who would do this?{wait}{clear}
...Hmph... Just go. This is no fun.{wait}{clear}
What do you want from me?{n}
What is it you want from me?{wait}{clear}
Hmph... Don't flatter yourself... I don't... need you.{wait}{clear}
I trust you as a hero...{wait}{clear}
You... how can you so lightly speak of trust and faith, such careless bonds...{wait}{clear}
